title: The destinations
description: What destinations.yml holds in a directory that `ingestion connectors apply` sends: each place an item is delivered, the side it takes, and the tags that place an item there. The side gate, a person's placement and every routing rule name a destination from here.

side.description: The side an item placed here takes. Left out, it takes neither, as a destination that drops what it takes does.

tags.description: Each tag that places an item here. A tag places an item on one destination only.
